creators.name: Gilles Pudlowski
creators.platform: blog / press (Les Pieds dans le Plat; Pudlo guides; Le Point)
creators.why: One of France's most established and widely-read food critics — long-time Gault&Millau and Le Point contributor, author of the Pudlo city guides, Alsace/Lorraine native. Real, verifiable track record and following; cited here with a specific named review for Brasserie Excelsior, S'Muensterstuewel and Le Grand Café Foy. Counts as an authoritative creator paired with a second credible source.
